messages:
marta: Heads-up: upcoming release train freeze window for the long-weekend stability push. Freeze starts 2025-07-04T00:00:00Z and ends 2025-07-06T23:59:59Z. Only critical fixes with approved exceptions allowed.
oliver: Can you clarify what counts as a 'critical fix'?
marta: Critical = production-severity P0/P1 incidents, security patches, or regressions that fail our smoke gate. Feature tweaks and non-urgent perf work should wait.
release-manager: Exception process: file the release-exception form (https://confluence.redwood/releases/exceptions) and tag @release-manager. We'll triage within 2 hours. Exceptions after freeze start require oncall approval + release lead signoff.
sre-oncall: New temporary alert policy for the freeze: auto-abort enabled for canaries if p95 > 400ms for 5m OR error_rate > 0.8% for 3m. If auto-abort triggers, an incident is created and paged to oncall.
marta: Note: we rolled out the auto-abort policy after the last incident. CTO requested automated safety nets for release windows.
ceo-bot: Exec note: please prioritize stability. Small teams, if you need extra runway, reach out to @marta.
infra-docs-bot: Added docs: "Freeze runbook & exception workflow" -> https://confluence.redwood/infra/freeze-runbook (internal).
oliver: Any change to canary cadence for this window?
release-manager: Yes - canaries will be more conservative: 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 20m observation at each step. Rollback will be automatic only for the metrics above; manual rollback still allowed if other issues surface.
sre-oncall: We'll run additional smoke checks after every stage using: ```./tools/canary-check --matrix default --max-p95 300``` and a custom probe suite against dedicated clusters.
marta: Reminder: no image bumps after freeze except emergency patches. If you must bump, include a justification and benchmark results in the exception form.
oliver: What about dedicated/private customers on reserved capacity - do we need to notify them?
release-manager: We'll publish a short note on status.redwood: "Planned stability freeze: no feature launches expected. There may be transient restarts for emergency fixes." For customers on scheduled maintenance lists, PMs will be notified directly.
sre-oncall: Oncall rotations extended: primary + secondary will both be paged during freeze. If auto-abort triggers, the deploy job will annotate the commit and revert the routing flag, e.g.:
```bash
# auto-abort fallback (internal)
./deploys/abort-and-revert --service route-proxy --to-tag previous && kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/route-proxy
```
release-manager: Small change in policy: we now require post-deploy blameless notes for any release that used an exception. Add a 2-3 line summary to the exception ticket within 24h.
infra-docs-bot: Policy update logged: "exception-postmortem: required for freeze exceptions". See docs link above.
oliver: For teams with scheduled demos next week, any guidance?
marta: If demo depends on new features, please reschedule or use a feature-flagged demo branch. Don't merge into main during freeze unless exception approved.
ceo-bot: Quick appreciation note: Thanks everyone for prioritizing reliability. This is a company priority. :clap:
sre-oncall: Monitoring checklist for freeze: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rates, cpu/mem, route-lookup-hitratio, kv-cache-miss. I'll post a short status update every 30m to this thread during the window.
release-manager: One operational addendum: deploy window on Thursday (pre-freeze) will include a dry run of the conservative canary cadence to validate auto-abort behaviors. Please avoid any unrelated changes during that 2h dry run.
oliver: Will we still do the weekly changelog post?
marta: Yes — changelog will be published Friday morning before freeze. It will call out the freeze and list notable commits included in this train.
release-manager: Final note: if you need help filling the exception form, ping me or use the template at /templates/release-exception.md in the repo.
sre-oncall: I'll start the pre-freeze probe run at 2025-07-03T22:00:00Z and share results here.
deploy-bot: Release freeze scheduled: start=2025-07-04T00:00:00Z, end=2025-07-06T23:59:59Z. Exceptions: submission required -> https://confluence.redwood/releases/exceptions
marta: Thanks all. Appreciate the cooperation 00%. If anything unexpected comes up, create an incident and tag this thread id 1765558888.
release-manager: Closing loop: exception form deadline for pre-freeze merges is 2025-07-03T20:00:00Z. After that time approvals will be emergency-only.
infra-docs-bot: Helpful checklist added to doc: "what to do during freeze".
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Will post heartbeat and any alerts here during freeze.
oliver: Acked. :white_check_mark:
